name: o-json: unwrap and extend a structure selection

actions.label: Lift fields out of their wrapper
actions.caption: ] unwraps the selected container. reviewed moves to the document root, removing a level that the output no longer needs.

actions.label: Extend a selection by a count
actions.caption: 2 starts a count and j extends VISUAL two rows downward. Select a small group of fields without repeating the motion.

notes.note: e opens the file chooser; ctrl+o shows our recent sample files.
Reset point: every action begins here again; earlier actions never change this starting state.
